document: Alone Against the Tide Solitaire Adventure by The Lakeshore (Call of Cthulhu MPRG 23174) (Nicholas Johnson, Lynne Hardy, Mike Mason etc.) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
Try as you might, you are unable to get the door open. No 
manner of fiddling with the lock will get it to budge. You even 
resort to force by attempting to throw your weight against 
the door.
With a sigh of resignation, you abandon your task.
